title: Devanagari alphabet
notable_features: Type of writing system: Abugida / Syllabic Alphabet
Writing direction: left to right in horizontal lines.
Script family: Proto-Sinaitic, Phoenician, Aramaic, Brāhmī, Gupta, Siddham, Nāgarī, Devanāgarī
Consonant letters carry an inherent vowel which can be altered or muted by means of diacritics or matra.
